feature_policy.remove_constant_in_train: only if all rows identical including missingness; retain single finite value plus NA as potentially informative
feature_policy.duplicates: exact full training rows including null pattern; baseline first, then lexical name; report alias; no validation-based decisions
feature_policy.baseline_freeze: build once on March-June and reuse identical retained columns in all R1 arms
feature_policy.family_filter: using train only; no minimum coverage percentage; each family compared to same baseline
feature_policy.source_missingness_reason: documented break, absent client-month, original NA of unknown cause; product absence only if supported by dictionary/data, never infer automatically
feature_policy.final_column_counts: compute and record before first fit; audit count 666 is provisional, not final

recipes.baseline: raw + lag1 + lag2 + delta1 + delta2 on reviewed sources
recipes.F4a: within-month average rank / nonnull count; zeros and negatives included, NA preserved

hyperparameter_search.interpretation: representation with its own equally budgeted tuning; not pure fixed-hyperparameter feature effect

evaluation.refit: freeze each arms best hyperparameters and best iteration; refit all five seeds at fixed iteration without additional early stopping

economic_rule.tie_break: score descending then client id ascending
economic_rule.augmentation_cut: full centered moving average width 2001 on August cumulative gain; earliest maximum; no edge padding
economic_rule.october_future_policy: freeze August ensemble contact proportion per arm; floor(proportion*N_october); no cut search in October

evaluation.promotion_rule: candidate mean paired AUC delta > 0 and wins >=4/5 versus B0; F4b additionally must meet same rule versus F4a to claim rank-history increment; record both comparisons regardless
evaluation.gain_role: diagnostic reported even if it contradicts AUC; no posthoc selection by whichever metric wins
evaluation.evidence_label: exploratory; 4/5 rule allocates compute and is not statistical significance
evaluation.confirmation: 20 paired seeds only in separately authorized stage

budget.stopping: external watchdog terminates only this run at cap, persists completed artifacts, records incomplete arms, shuts down VM; no substantive final comparison unless every arm completed identical budget
budget.pilot_budget_gate: Already calibrated. Explicit authorization to run complete experiment; enforce 16 hour cap.

future_long_history_branch.control: baseline refit on June, same source and preprocessing policy
future_long_history_branch.common_source_formula_pairs: recompute under revised missingness policy; old 451 count pertains only to 90-percent audit
